name: Biometric Attendance Summary
query:
SELECT
  ec.employee AS "Employee:Link/Employee:140",
  ec.employee_name AS "Employee Name::220",
  DATE(ec.time) AS "Date:Date:100",
  MIN(CASE WHEN ec.log_type = 'IN' THEN ec.time END) AS "First IN:Datetime:150",
  MAX(CASE WHEN ec.log_type = 'OUT' THEN ec.time END) AS "Last OUT:Datetime:150",
  COUNT(*) AS "Biometric Checkins:Int:110"
FROM `tabEmployee Checkin` ec
WHERE IFNULL(ec.biometric_event_key, '') != ''
GROUP BY ec.employee, ec.employee_name, DATE(ec.time)
ORDER BY DATE(ec.time) DESC, ec.employee
